Title: Azure HDInsight now supports Private Link in preview

Body.Content:
Azure HDInsight now supports private link integration in preview in all regions. you can now remove the public IPs and create fully isolated clusters in a VNET.

By using these new settings, you can also skip the inbound network security group (NSG) service tag rules for HDInsight management IPs. Learn more about how to create private clusters.
